NAME
  dcgm-exporter config
  Inspect settings without starting the exporter

USAGE
  dcgm-exporter config [OPTIONS]

COMMANDS
  show
    Print the effective settings as a config file; does not read the files they
    name
  validate
    Check the settings and the local files they name; exit 1 when invalid
  explain
    Explain where each setting came from and what will be collected

GENERAL OPTIONS
  --help, -h
    Show command help
    Default: false
